documents.title: Refund policy
documents.text: Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days after we receive the returned item.

documents.title: Shipping times
documents.text: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 working days; express arrives the next day if ordered before noon.

documents.title: Password reset
documents.text: Use the Forgot password link on the sign-in page; the reset email expires after 30 minutes.

documents.title: Invoices
documents.text: Invoices are available as PDF under Billing, History for the last 24 months.

documents.title: Cancelling a subscription
documents.text: You can cancel anytime under Plan settings; access continues until the end of the billing period.

documents.title: Data export
documents.text: Export all your projects as a ZIP archive from Settings, Data, Export.

documents.title: Two-factor authentication
documents.text: Turn on two-factor authentication with an authenticator app under Security.

documents.title: API rate limits
documents.text: The API allows 600 requests per minute per key; exceeding it returns HTTP 429.

documents.title: Warranty
documents.text: Hardware is covered for two years against manufacturing defects.

documents.title: Account deletion
documents.text: Deleting your account permanently erases your data after a 14-day grace period.

documents.title: Pricing
documents.text: The Pro plan costs 12 EUR per month and adds unlimited projects.

documents.title: Gift cards
documents.text: Gift cards never expire and can be combined with other promotions.
